recipe.visualDefinition: A minimalist 1960s-style album cover featuring a central female figure in a cocktail dress seated on a black horizontal line, positioned below two rows of large, bold slab-serif typography against a cream-colored, slightly aged background.
coreVisualRelationships: Typography dominates the upper half of the composition
Subject is grounded by a thick black horizontal baseline
Color palette links the subject's dress to the primary headline
Vast negative space creates a clean, mid-century modern aesthetic
coreInvariants: Single photographic subject in a seated pose
Horizontal black bar at the bottom edge

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Small-scale female figure centered horizontally in the lower third of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: A thick black horizontal line at the bottom of the image.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Top-down: starting with the large blue headline, moving to the green sub-headline, and resting on the seated figure.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive cream-colored negative space surrounding the central figure and separating the text blocks.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low-saturation, mid-value tones for a faded, vintage print appearance.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to three primary ink colors plus black

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Extra-bold slab serif with square proportions
letterConstructionRules: Uniform stroke weight with minimal contrast
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Two colors of the same typeface family for primary and secondary headlines.
graphicDevices: Small metadata block at top center

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy slab-serif weight and geometric structure.
Classic mid-century slab serif with similar proportions.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a studio photograph of a woman in 1960s cocktail attire (teal dress, pearls, bouffant hair) seated on a thin black floor line against a vast, textured cream-colored wall. Leave the top 60% of the frame empty.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add two lines of centered, uppercase text in a heavy slab-serif font. The top line should be teal/cyan and the second line should be olive green. Place a small line of metadata and a simple geometric logo at the very top center.

verificationChecks: Is the background a warm, aged cream color?
Is the text a heavy slab-serif?
Is there a thick black line at the bottom?
Is the subject small relative to the typography?

postGenerationChecks: Check that the black baseline is perfectly horizontal
Verify the cream background has a subtle paper-like texture
Confirm the slab-serifs are blocky and bold
recipe.reuseFormula: Subject [Person] + Baseline [Black Bar] + Background [Cream Texture] + Typography [Bold Slab Serif Stacked]
